summary: Aehr Test Systems filed an 8-K reporting that it fully utilized its at-the-market equity offering program, completing sales of common stock with aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $60 million. The shares were sold under the company's effective Form S-3 registration statement (File No. 333-282661) and a prospectus supplement dated April 8, 2026, which registered up to $100 million of securities. This is a routine capital raise without any special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. The filing involves no board recommendation, advisors, premium, or structural complexity. No further action or risk-arb angle is relevant.
